Class TextLabel

java.lang.Object
com.trevlar.menukit.api.element.AbstractPanelElement
com.trevlar.menukit.api.element.TextLabel
All Implemented Interfaces:
PanelElement
public class TextLabel extends AbstractPanelElement
A line of text in a Panel, fixed or read every frame. 
TextLabel.builder().text(Component.literal("Restock")).at(0, 0).build();
TextLabel.builder().text(() -> Component.literal("Bees: " + bees())).color(TextLabel.COLOR_LIGHT).shadow(true).build();

Wrap

A label wider than the room its panel gives it wraps onto several lines (vanilla's own line breaking) and the panel pushes what is below it down; a wider pass puts it back on one line. A HUD label, which has no panel budget, can be given a fixed wrapWidth.

Disabled look

While its own disabledWhen holds, or its panel or container is disabled, the label draws in the disabled grey (§0066): the text of a greyed settings group greys with its controls, with no colour swapping by hand.

ARGB (26.2)

A colour must carry an alpha byte (0xFF404040, not 0x404040): vanilla silently drops text whose alpha is zero.

Supplier text and layout

A label's width is its text's. Text that changes width every frame moves the panel's layout with it; keep alternatives about the same width, or give the panel a pinned width.
